senses.gloss:
__1 A seat covered with bark. 
__2 N. of an enemy of Viṣṇu.

__1 N. of a fabulous mountain (round which all the planets are said to revolve and which forms the centre of the several Dvīpas; cf. द्वीप; it is also said to consist of gold and gems); विभज्य मेरुर्न यदर्थिसात् कृतः [[N. 1. 16]]; स्वात्मन्येव समाप्तहेममहिमा मेरुर्न मे रोचते [[Bh. 3. 150.]] 
__2 The central bead in a rosary. 
__3 The central gem of a necklace. 
-Comp. 
-अद्रिकर्णिका the earth. 
-धामन् m. an epithet of Śiva. 
-पृष्ठम् heaven, the sky. 
-मन्दरः N. of a mountain. 
-यन्त्रम् a figure shaped like a spindle. 
-सावर्णः N. of one of the fourteen Manus.
